en: A black and white historic postcard depicting a quiet rural street with a large two-story building on the right, likely of European architectural style. There are a few people standing on the dirt road and a wooden fence lines the street. The left side shows fields and more buildings in the background, with trees and telegraph poles visible. The text at the top left reads 'Ockelbo. Apoteket.'
